user.title: Add a device
user.description: Search the network for NDI® decoders, or choose the device type yourself (also for the Dante® network).

manual.title: Choose the device type
manual.description: Choose the protocol and device type. Each NDI® device (decoder) becomes one entry; its outputs become destinations of the matrix. Dante® network adds all Dante devices of the network at once.

scan.title: Search the network
scan.description: Every address of the subnet is asked (read-only, no login) whether it is a supported decoder. Takes a few seconds.

data_description.subnet: IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation, e.g. 192.0.2.0/24 (at most /22). Defaults to Home Assistant's own network.

pick.title: Decoders found
pick.description: {count} new decoder(s) found. Devices that are already set up are not listed.

confirm.title: {device}
confirm.description: Add **{name}** ({host})? The connection is tested before the device is added. Magewell: the factory login is pre-filled - enter your own if you changed it.

data_description.password: Magewell factory default: Admin (change it!). BirdDog: only needed if the API requires a login.
data_description.name: Defaults to the device's own name.

device.title: {device}
device.description: The connection is tested before the device is added.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the device, e.g. 192.0.2.10.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default port of this device type.
data_description.password: Magewell factory default: Admin (change it!). BirdDog: only needed if the API requires a login.
data_description.name: Defaults to the device's own name.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the stored credentials.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure device
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the device, e.g. 192.0.2.10.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default port of this device type.
data_description.password: Magewell factory default: Admin (change it!). BirdDog: only needed if the API requires a login.

network.title: Dante® network
network.description: All Dante® devices on the network are found automatically via mDNS (no login needed) and appear as devices: TX channels become sources, RX channels destinations. Unofficial protocol - not affiliated with Audinate. Dante Domain Manager, AES67-only devices and multicast flows are not supported.

data_description.static_hosts: Only needed if mDNS does not reach Home Assistant (other VLAN): IP addresses of Dante devices, comma separated.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device (wrong address/port, or it is not this device type).
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the user name or password.
error.invalid_subnet: Not a valid IPv4 subnet (e.g. 192.0.2.0/24, at most /22).
error.no_devices_found: No new decoders found in this subnet.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different device.
abort.network_reconfigure: Nothing to reconfigure: Dante devices are found automatically. Use the options instead.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported decoder.
abort.already_in_progress: This device is already being set up.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two polls. Offline devices are retried with a growing pause (up to 30 s).

display.title: Linked display: {destination}
display.description: Optional: a TV or projector (any media_player) fed by this destination. Leave empty for none.

data.auto_on: Power on and switch input on route
data.off_on_none: Turn display off when routed to None

display_input.title: Display input: {destination}
display_input.description: Input of {display} the decoder is connected to (e.g. HDMI 2). Leave empty to only power it on.

data.only_selected: Create entities only for selected RX channels

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two polls of the subscriptions.
data_description.devices: Unticked devices are ignored completely (no device, no sources, no destinations).
data_description.only_selected: Default: entities for every RX channel (devices with more than 32 RX channels start with disabled entities). The matrix card always shows all channels.
data_description.static_hosts: IP addresses of Dante devices mDNS does not reach, comma separated.

rx_channels.title: RX channels with entities
rx_channels.description: Pick the RX channels that get a source selector and a subscription sensor.

no_destination.message: No AV Matrix destination in the target.

invalid_dante_source.message: Not a Dante source: "{source}". Expected channel@device, e.g. CH1@AVIOAES3-05b2c4.

route.name: Route
route.description: Route a source to one or more destinations.

source.name: Source
source.description: Source name (NDI®: the full NDI name) or its label. "None" switches the destination off.

destination.name: Destination ids
destination.description: Destination ids from the WebSocket snapshot (alternative to the entity target, e.g. for Dante RX channels whose entities are disabled).

salvo.name: Salvo
salvo.description: Switch several destinations at once. All are validated first; if one is unknown or locked, nothing is switched.

routes.name: Routes
routes.description: List of routes, each with destination (a source select entity) and source (name, label or None).
